base: Use case: production game sprites. Create ONE original transparent PNG sprite atlas for Arena Criolla, a Venezuelan arcade fighter. Landscape exact 2:1 aspect ratio, ideally 2048x1024. EXACTLY EIGHT separate complete full-body poses in FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows. Match the polished inked cel-shaded realistic illustrated style, dark subtle outlines, detailed fabric, natural human proportions and clear expressive face of the SECOND reference (style ONLY; do not reuse its person or outfit). The FIRST reference defines the new person's likeness. Every figure faces RIGHT in three-quarter view with the face visible. Keep the SAME face, hair, costume, accessories and scale across all 8 poses. TOP ROW left-to-right: 1 relaxed idle/characteristic stance, 2 raised guarding hands, 3 running left leg forward, 4 running right leg forward. BOTTOM ROW: 5 airborne tucked-knee jump, 6 extended right-arm strike/characteristic gesture, 7 high right side kick with other foot planted, 8 recoiling hurt lean back. Each figure and its held props must form ONE connected opaque silhouette. Full limbs and shoes entirely visible, generous margins and gutters. Align standing feet consistently within each row. No shadow, floor, text, letters, labels, logos, frame, grid, detached objects, particles, duplicates, extra people, cropped extremities. Truly transparent alpha outside the 8 silhouettes, not a checkerboard.
